main_text.p: ordio,quod,vel ἐπαναλήψει[?] repetitione coñ[?] stat breui gratulationis ab amico institu-tæ. lib.4. epist. 14. vel significationē lætitiæ ex eadem perceptæ.lib.15.epist.6.Pars altera est Propositio, quę gratulationis p-dicationē & gratiarum actionem habet. l.4.e.14. l.15.e.6. Pars tertia Confirmatio; in qua rationes &argumenta adferuntur: quare, aut gratæ nobis acceptæq; amico-rum sint gratulationes, eademq; à causis, adiunctis,comparatis sumuntur. l.15.e.6. aut admitti gratulationes non possint.li.4.epist.14. aut factum admissumue fit id, de quo amicus nobis gratulatur. lib.4.e-pi.14. Pars quarta Conclusio, absoluitur: vel ἀπολύεσθαι[?] officij pollicitatione. lib.4.e-pist.14.vel ἀξιώσει[?] petitione. lib.15.epist.6.

Nam & amicus rogatur, vt perpetuò ani-matus in nos esse bene velit: & vicilsim omnia humanitatis,beneuolentiæ,grati-Materiæ re- sponsionum ad epistolas gratulato- rias.tudinis eidem officia deferuntur. Sūt au-tem huius generis epistolę modò indica-tæ.Respons.ad gratulationem de recupe-rata in vrbe dignitate,& nouis nuptiis.li.4.epist.14. & honoribus.libr.15.epistol.6.Imitationis exemplum.Quam hoc imitari tempore respondebi-mus ei qui de officio nobis est ac condi-tione gratulatus: & quatuor illas expri-mere

page.notes: Greek words ἐπαναλήψει, ἀπολύεσθαι and ἀξιώσει are uncertain in the small scan and are marked [?]. "coñ" at the end of the first line is uncertain and marked [?]. The left-margin notes are italic and run across several lines; the first note's position is approximated beside "tudinis" and "tem huius". Printed hyphens at line ends kept as printed.
